messages.plaintextBody:
Lunch & Learn this month: a practical session on warranty & indemnity insurance in mid-market deals, led by a guest underwriter. Tuesday 25 November, 1.00-2.00pm, Room 4 / Teams. 1 CPD hour. Sandwiches provided.
